snippet.title: ASHEN LEGACY | OFFICIAL TRAILER | 2D PIXEL ACTION RPG
snippet.description:
⚔️ ASHEN LEGACY is a fast-paced 2D Pixel Action RPG set in a dark fantasy world.

Fight monsters, face powerful bosses, discover new equipment, unlock skills, and uncover the story hidden within the world of Ashen Legacy.

🔥 The journey is only beginning.

Wishlist Ashen Legacy on Steam and follow the development:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/5164260/Ashen_Legacy
